beats.title: An ordinary day
beats.pointAt: The story view and the waiting strip: cash in, an ATM withdrawal, a paper slip waiting for the supervisor; on the bank map, money moving between the houses, the branch and the ATM

beats.title: Books that cannot disagree

beats.claim: The token and the ledger entry are one transaction

beats.title: Try to break it
beats.pointAt: One refusal after another, each with its reason, and a barrier dropping on the bank map for each
beats.claim: The chain decides; an agent's instructions are not the control

beats.title: Fraud, with a way back
beats.pointAt: The scenario card, the transfer waiting for an approver, the freeze, the reversal waiting for compliance, then the pass

beats.title: Money creation and stress

cards.title: Beat 1: An ordinary day
cards.pointAt: The story view and the waiting strip: cash in, an ATM withdrawal, a paper slip waiting for the supervisor; on the bank map, money moving between the houses, the branch and the ATM
cards.claim: It reads like a bank, in plain sentences

checks.name: cash paid in at the counter
the ATM withdrawal waits for the dispense
cash withdrawn at the ATM
a transfer from the app
the paper slip waits for the supervisor
and goes through once approved
a larger card transfer climbs the ladder
drawer cash above the float moved to the vault under dual control
the teller's drawer counts as booked
cash moved with deposits on the ledger
the reconciliation line reports a match
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.title: Beat 2: Books that cannot disagree
cards.pointAt: One cash deposit opened from the story: the ledger entry it posted, the two balance sheet rows it moved, and the invariant strip
cards.claim: The token and the ledger entry are one transaction

checks.name: one cash deposit at the counter
the tokens are created and the entry posted in the same transaction
the entry is posted by the cash module

cards.title: Beat 3: Try to break it
cards.pointAt: One refusal after another, each with its reason, and a barrier dropping on the bank map for each
cards.claim: The chain decides; an agent's instructions are not the control

checks.name: approving its own operation is refused
calling the forced transfer directly is refused
acting at this branch with a teller role for another is refused
replaying a used authorisation is refused, naming the one-use number
sending to an account that is not onboarded is refused, naming the allow-list
more than the app limit is refused
a payee never registered is paid no more than the small limit
a standing order to a payee never registered is refused
no balance changes
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.title: Beat 4: Fraud, with a way back
cards.pointAt: The scenario card, the transfer waiting for an approver, the freeze, the reversal waiting for compliance, then the pass
cards.claim: No member of staff acts alone, and a wrong is reversed on the record

checks.name: the transfer waits for an approver
the teller alone cannot complete it
it goes through only once a supervisor approves
the teller, approver and slip hash are on record
the customer is told at once: the operation's event names her
the money left her account
her dispute freezes the money where it went
the recipient cannot move it on
back office proposes the reversal
the reversal waits for compliance
compliance approves it, and the money returns
the customer is whole again
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.title: Beat 5: Money creation and stress
cards.pointAt: The capital ratio falling to its minimum and the refused drawdown; then the payment queue growing and draining as treasury sells securities, the water tower emptying and vans queueing at the post office gate
cards.claim: Lending creates money only within limits; a bank can be solvent and still run short

checks.name: the capital ratio falls towards its minimum, never below it
a drawdown is refused naming the capital ratio
the refused drawdown creates no tokens
a smaller loan within the ratio still goes through
the capital ratio holds after it
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger
the payments out join the queue
the queue stops where the settlement account runs short
no payment is released beyond the settlement balance
the liquidity ratio falls as the payments leave
treasury sells securities, booked on the custodian’s confirmation
every queued payment goes through once funded
the next statements of the clearing system and the custodian match
lending is refused while the liquidity ratio is below its minimum
the bank stays solvent throughout
the money comes back once the run subsides
the liquidity ratio recovers above its minimum
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.title: All devices lost

checks.name: the recovery waits for the supervisor
then goes through once approved
the customer is notified through every contact: the recovery is on record
the old signers are gone
a new phone and card are enrolled
the lost phone can no longer sign
the address and balance are unchanged
no money moved
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: A customer loses every device and their card, and the bank gives them their account back without letting anyone else in.
cards.control: Recovery module: an account opening officer with a supervisor's approval, signer list only

cards.title: ATM fails to dispense

checks.name: the amount waits as pending
the reported failure returns it
the customer is whole after the first run
with no report it stays pending
and is flagged
the count returns it
the customer's balance is restored in full
ATM cash is unchanged
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: The ATM takes a withdrawal but fails to pay out the cash, and the customer must not lose the money.

cards.title: Payment rejected

checks.name: the customer pays
the payment leaves
the signed rejection is accepted
the same rejection is accepted only once
the customer's balance is back where it started
the settlement account is back where it started
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: Another bank rejects a payment a customer sent, and the money must come back to them.
cards.control: Payments module checks the clearing system's signed rejection

cards.title: Unknown beneficiary

checks.name: the funds wait in suspense
the module holds them meanwhile
compliance returns them to the sender
no customer is credited
suspense is empty after the return
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: Money arrives for an account the bank does not have, so it waits aside and then goes back to the sender.
cards.control: Suspense account in the payments module

cards.title: Forged credit advice

checks.name: the forged advice is refused, naming the partner key
the forged advice creates no deposit tokens
the genuine advice is accepted
the replay is refused, naming the repeated reference
the replay creates no deposit tokens
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: Someone fakes a message from the clearing system saying money arrived, then replays a real one; neither may create money.
cards.control: Signature check and unique reference in the payments module

cards.title: Flagged payment in

checks.name: both payments wait for compliance
the settlement account rises at once
the customer cannot spend the amount until it is cleared
the cleared payment reaches the customer
the other is returned to its sender
the customer has the cleared one only
the returned one left the settlement account
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: A large payment arrives and waits for compliance to clear or return it before the customer can use it.
cards.control: Screening in the payments module, compliance clearance

cards.title: Ledger mismatch

checks.name: the reconciliation line fails
the figure is marked, not current
the cash count that differs is marked too
nothing is posted to make them agree
the incident is recorded and reported
once the fee is refunded, the next statement matches
the vault counted again matches
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: An outside statement or a cash count disagrees with the bank's books, and the bank must notice and report it.
cards.control: The attested figures contract's comparison with the ledger; reconciliation by finance

cards.title: Pause and resume

checks.name: risk pauses the bank
a transfer is refused as paused
a cash deposit at the counter is refused as paused
paying into savings is refused as paused
the scheduler is refused while paused, so nothing is missed
nothing moves while paused
risk cannot resume
governance's resume waits for its time lock
governance resumes after the time lock
money moves again
the scheduler runs again once the bank resumes
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: Risk stops the bank in an incident, then tries to start it again itself; only governance can, and only after its time lock.
cards.control: Pause by risk on the deposit token, where every movement ends; resume only by governance multi-signature and time lock

cards.title: Loan in arrears

checks.name: the loan is drawn with its performing allowance
the borrower cancels its mandate
the missed collections put it into arrears, then default at the third
the allowance rises at the set rates
governance writes it off against the allowance, the shortfall on equity
the books balance
the cash split sums to the ledger

cards.summary: A borrower cancels their loan's mandate, so its instalments cannot be collected: it goes into arrears, then default, and is written off.
cards.control: Scheduled collection under the borrower's mandate, the loan's stage and its loss allowance
